text_block_list.text: —The traveler said.
"The scent of the wind has changed," she said.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And rounding the fourth corner!!
Four runners are neck and neck at the front!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista!!
Where on earth is Buena Vista charging in from?!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: —I won't... lose...!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Surging from the outside!! Buena Vista!!
Is she going to sweep past them all at once!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Here comes Buena Vista from the outside!! Buena Vista!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Can she reach them?! Buena Vista!!
Can she make it? They're neck and neckkkk!!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant, pant*...!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The photo finish results are in!
First place goes to number 7, Buena Vista!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista,
achieves the Double Tiaraaaaa--!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I did it――

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I did it…… I did it……!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaay!!!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan A
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOH!! Buena Vista,
congrats on the Double Tiaraaaa!!!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan
text_block_list.text:
Holy crap...!! Number one favorite every single time, straight wins, and now the Double Tiara!!
She's literally the new heroine!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vistaaa!!
Congrats on the Double Tiara!!
You were so, so cool out there--!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"That final straight was insanely awesome!!
Thank you for such an exhilarating race!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...!
Thank you all so very much...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: To have so many people cheering for me... and being so happy for me...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm soooo happy right now!!!
I'll never forget this breathtaking view!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I love you all so much!!
Please keep cheering for me from now on, too!!
(WOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Haaah~~... What a good kid...
Always giving it her all, always shining so brightly...

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan D
text_block_list.text: I know, right~...! It just makes you want to root for her, or something—

text_block_list.name: Buena Fan D
text_block_list.text: I just can't help but love it...!

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
—Having just won the Japanese Oaks the other day,
Buena Vista has brilliantly achieved the Double Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Show Host
text_block_list.text:
"She has once again declared her ambition
for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe.
Please take a look at the footage—"

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
“—So you are officially
aiming for the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe'!”

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've only registered for now,
and haven't officially decided to run yet—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I plan to run in the Sapporo Kinen this summer
and check my condition there.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text: I see! If you choose to enter the 'Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe', the schedule will make running in the 'Shuka Sho' virtually impossible, but—

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Even now, it seems many fans are still hoping for the Triple Tiara...!
What are your thoughts on that?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Um... There are so many people placing their hopes and dreams on me,
and I just feel so, so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: So whether I can run in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe or not... even if plans change and I end up running in the Shuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No matter the venue, I want to give it my all
and show everyone a dream...
a "spectacular view"!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Man, that was such a straightforward comment!
It naturally raises high hopes for her future—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...You're quite popular, Buena-san.

Right now, the racing world is paying close attention
to Buena Vista, the dazzling new heroine who burst onto the Tiara route...
Her skill goes without saying, but it seems many fans are also charmed by her single-minded, pure demeanor.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I can't help but love it—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...It must be pure natural talent.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Her innocent power to captivate people
is utterly extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: So much so... it was truly historic.
choice_data_list: Then as I thought, she is—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Without a doubt, they are destined to become a "storm."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Therefore... I wish to face you...—

...Why is it?
Whenever I look upon Dream Journey's smile—

I felt something akin to a premonition...
that our confrontation would materialize before long.

"And I realized that a part of me, too,
was truly looking forward to this showdown—"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Um... The books on overseas races are...—
—Hello, Buena.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san!
Good afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...Could it be that you're looking for
a book about French races?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh, wow...! How did you know!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Just a hunch.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...If you like, please make use of the Expedition Support Committee. I believe they would have far more comprehensive materials for what you are looking for—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Journey-san!
Thank you so much for teaching me so many things.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Thanks to you, I found so many of the reference materials I was looking for!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "That is what the Expedition Support Committee is here for, after all. I'm just glad we could be of help."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: All right...! I need to read a lot and study super hard...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...May I ask you a quick question?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes!
What is it?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Just what is the reason
that you are aiming for the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...I want to show them.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "To everyone who supports me, I will show you an unforgettable 'breathtaking view'...!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Just like that race I saw back then...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ――"Japan Cup."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Japan's Supreme Commander, Special Week,
faced off against the world's strongest, Montjeu,
in a legendary race—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Special Week's run that day……
it was as if she carried all the hopes and dreams of Japan's race fans on her shoulders—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: It was a brilliance akin to a shooting star...—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...!! I totally get it!!
I get it so, so well!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"The whole venue became one that day...
Everyone was so moved...!!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Special Week-san was so cool and sparkling after winning!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I...! The tears just won't stop...!!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, huh?
How did you know "that race" meant Spe-san's Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Ah, that is—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Because I already knew
that you admired Special Week-san.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If there's an unforgettable race to speak of when it comes to her,
I'd say it has to be the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...I thought that might be the case, so I gave it a shot.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Amazing...! Just like a great detective...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...You, just like Special Week-san, want to create an unforgettable race full of emotion.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: "So that is why you're aiming for it... The Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
If only I could show someone else the emotions,
the dreams that I was given back then—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's the kind of Umamusume
I've always been striving to be...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: How wonderful—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Um, Journey-san,
you're planning to run in the upcoming Takarazuka Kinen, right?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Hm? Yes, that's right, but—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm cheering for you!
For you to make everyone's dreams come true, Journey-san!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The way you run, Journey-san, it's so sharp and powerful...!
To be honest, I absolutely love it!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Someday, I would love to compete in the same race with you.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I love the way you run, too...
Because it fills me with dreams.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
R-Really!?
Wah... I'm so happy...!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Fufu—

As the flap of a butterfly's wings eventually creates a storm,
cause and effect intertwine, stepping forward.
Listening to the pursuing sound, the traveler presses on along the path—
